reasons.action: No explicit new action or performance is requested; the continuation preserves the source clip’s observed action.
reasons.medium: The medium decision preserves the live-action rendering; no restyle or alternate medium is requested.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory changes are requested, so the observed figure’s appearance is retained.
reasons.lighting: No instruction about a light source, direction, or visible quality is given; observed lighting is preserved.
reasons.framing: No requested camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint, or movement is specified; ending on the anchor does not itself request new framing.
reasons.palette: No explicit color grade or tonal contrast treatment is requested; the reference palette governs.
